tasks.short: Discuss pupil progress and priorities with parents

steps.what: Review the child's progress evidence and existing support arrangements
Meet parents or guardians to discuss progress, priorities and resource needs
Write parent correspondence about progress and the proposed priorities
Check and send the final correspondence to the correct parent or guardian
Write the agreed priorities in the existing pupil contact record

tasks.design: Use a focused pupil view in {LMS}, the existing parent-message layout in {EMAIL} and current contact-entry fields. The teacher retains dialogue and writes actual priorities, then checks the exact parent send; ordinary record saves remain ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Progress navigation and repeated message/contact context add clerical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pupil views and reusable stable message sections reduce those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Agreeing priorities and resource needs requires understanding the child and family.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher listens, explains and negotiates workable support.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated contact paperwork with unchanged parent collaboration.

reach.learn: Which family concerns need specialist follow-up

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records and parent communication; this supports those software categories without establishing a middle-school installation or measured saving.
The specific native-view and writing benefit is unmeasured.

assumptions: Shares describe a mix of meeting and correspondence work, not a requirement to send a letter after every meeting. The existing pupil contact entry is read for continuing support; no new meeting transcript is added.

Teachers produce progress records through assessment, school administration maintains authorised contacts, and the parent discussion produces priorities. This task counts context checking in s1 and actual priority capture in s3/s5; missing or disputed evidence requires manual review.

Native views remove three of15 navigation hours. Stable message sections remove7.5 of25 setup/repeated-context hours; contact-field defaults remove one of10 repeated-identifier hours. Actual pupil-specific writing and ordinary saves remain.
No model pupil judgement or automated parent send is proposed.
unknowns: Whether current contact tools already reuse these fields
research_questions: Which message content is stable context rather than new progress explanation?

already_counted.description: Reference checks and actual correspondence/contact writing remain in s1, s3 and s5.

incremental.description: Teacher checks message sections after support-process changes.

approvals.approved_version: Actual pupil-specific statement or question checked before speaking; changed topics require renewed judgement.
Exact pupil, progress statements, priorities, message version and authorised recipient checked before sending; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R88.5, gross11.5 less upkeep1 gives net10.5. Low1 retains all15 reference hours,23 correspondence and all10 contact-entry hours when messages are mostly bespoke, plus50 meeting/send hours: R98, net1. High7 retains14 reference,19.5 correspondence and9.5 contact hours with partly reusable sections, plus50 other hours: R92, net7. Central retains12,17.5 and nine clerical hours respectively.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach and monitor safe equipment and material use

steps.what: Check the physical equipment, materials and immediate safety conditions
Instruct students and demonstrate safe use and care of equipment and materials
Monitor students' actual use and intervene to prevent injury or damage

tasks.design: Keep practical checking, instruction and live monitoring with the teacher. A reference in {DOCS} can support existing instruction, but no template or native view removes a step from this direct supervision task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safety depends on actual equipment and student behaviour.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change in this design removes direct checking or supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Unsafe actions require immediate contextual intervention.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher sees and corrects risky use as it happens.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in direct safe-use supervision.

reach.learn: Which equipment conditions need correction before use

evidence.claim: A software reference cannot replace physical setup checks or live supervision in this design.

assumptions: The task covers actual instruction and monitoring, not a routinely kept written safety report. No log of ordinary supervision is introduced; incident reporting, where required after an actual incident, is a separate event rather than invented routine work.
The teacher produces the checked setup in s1 and observes student activity in s3; all capture and interpretation time remains. There is no machine step relying on a structured safety flag.
Native views, templates and equipment instructions were considered; they do not remove direct practical checking or watching students. No record write is hidden in these in-person steps.
No change means no incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Whether any separate written preparation activity exists today
research_questions: Is there actual recurring written preparation beyond this direct instruction and supervision?

already_counted.description: All practical checking, instruction and monitoring remain.

approvals.approved_version: Actual demonstration, equipment and student group checked for immediate safety before performance; changed conditions require renewed judgement.
Actual intervention or corrective instruction checked for the observed behaviour before acting; changed circumstances require renewed judgement.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R100, gross0 and upkeep0 give net0. Both bounds retain physical setup15, direct instruction40 and live monitoring45 hours; no routine record or preparation write is assumed absent evidence it exists.

tasks.short: Discuss individual pupils with other professionals

steps.what: Gather current evidence about the student's needs and progress
Meet colleagues to discuss the student's needs, progress and suitable support
Write the agreed support actions in the existing pupil support plan
Check and circulate the final action plan to the participating professionals

tasks.design: Use a focused pupil-support view and reusable action fields in {LMS}. The teacher discusses needs with colleagues, writes actual agreed actions and checks the version circulated through {EMAIL}; no meeting transcript or automated pupil judgement is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Gathering support evidence and repeatedly writing standard action context add clerical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native support-record views and reusable fields can remove that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Professionals need to reconcile different observations and practical constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher connects classroom experience with colleagues' expertise.
tasks.altitude: Less support-plan setup with unchanged professional discussion.

reach.learn: Which agreed actions need clearer ownership

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil and support-plan records; the digest does not demonstrate automated professional discussion or a local time outcome.

assumptions: The existing support action plan is read by participating school professionals and is distinct from the parent-contact entry in18639. It records actual actions rather than a newly invented conversation log.

Teaching and support staff produce progress observations in their existing work. The teacher checks sources in s1, the meeting produces actions in s2 and the teacher captures owner, action and timing in s3. Missing evidence or uncertain ownership requires manual clarification, fully retained.

Native pupil views remove four of20 navigation hours. Reusable support fields remove three of15 repeated-context writing hours; actual actions, dates, checks and ordinary saves remain without self-approval.
This scenario is an internal school-professional meeting. Any real external professional disclosure needs the actual recipient/version check and appropriate authority; no extra send is assumed here.
unknowns: Whether current support views already combine relevant records
research_questions: Which action fields are repeated context rather than new pupil-specific decisions?

already_counted.description: Context checks and actual action writing remain in s1 and s3.

incremental.description: Teacher checks support fields after process changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact pupil scope, actions, owners, dates and participating recipients checked before circulation; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R93, gross7 less upkeep0.5 gives net6.5. Low0 retains current work where the support view and action fields already exist and no change is adopted. High4 retains18 context hours and12.5 action-writing hours because sources remain partly separate, plus65 meeting/send hours: R95.5, net4. Central retains16 context and12 writing hours with compatible support records.

tasks.short: Prepare required pupil and activity reports

steps.what: Collect and complete the source records needed for the required student report
outputs: checked report source entries and scope

steps.what: Compile student and activity figures for the report period
inputs: checked report source entries and scope
outputs: draft report figures with source references

steps.what: Prepare the report layout and its required contextual sections
inputs: draft report figures with source references

steps.what: Draft comments explaining the reported student progress and activities
inputs: checked report source entries and scope

loop.input: Teacher-selected report entries, activity notes and verified figures
loop.output: Descriptive comments with sentence-level source references and explicit missing information
loop.check: Teacher verifies meaning, attribution, date and completeness against the original notes and figures; no inferred ability, emotion, diagnosis or unsupported causal claim
loop.stop: One draft only; unsupported comments are removed or written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables and fixed headings handle structured content first; residual activity explanations vary across narrative notes

steps.what: Review the whole report and correct figures, context and comments
inputs: checked report source entries and scope

steps.what: Check and send the final required report to administration

tasks.design: Use a native report query in {LMS} and the required layout in {DOCS}, with a bounded draft only for descriptive comments. The teacher completes missing sources, checks the whole report and checks the exact version sent through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual compilation, layout setup and narrative organisation repeat existing pupil information.
tasks.enabler_now: Native queries and reusable layouts can remove structured preparation before narrative assistance is considered.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete records and misleading explanations still require teacher review.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows whether a report fairly represents the pupil and activity.
tasks.altitude: Prepare required reports with less compilation while preserving source completion and fair description.

reach.task: Use required pupil and activity reports
reach.learn: Which requested fields support an actual decision

evidence.claim: ParnasSys provides pupil and learning-goal records; it supports a source-record category but the digest does not establish this report's query or comment quality.
The query, layout and bounded comment benefit are unmeasured local design estimates.

assumptions: The report is required and read by administration. Meeting and parent-contact records remain authored once in their own tasks; this report reuses sources without claiming their original authoring time again.

Teachers produce marks and observations through existing teaching work; administration produces required fields and period definitions. s1 counts selecting pupil/activity identifiers, period, source values and notes and capturing missing entries, retaining all20 hours. No free progress code or complete structured activity record is assumed.

Native reporting is tested first. The query removes25 manual compilation hours; layout reuse removes10 of20 formatting/context hours; the bounded comment draft removes six of20 narrative-organisation hours. Source completion and whole-report review remain full.
No grading, learning-outcome decision, automated pupil score, hidden record commit or automatic send is proposed. Ordinary draft saving earns no saving or approval stage.
unknowns: Compatibility of administrative definitions with current pupil records
How much comment text has sufficient original evidence
research_questions: Can every required figure and descriptive sentence be traced to a completed source entry without extra uncounted capture?

already_counted.description: Source completion, comment checking and whole-report review remain in s1, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Teacher checks query definitions and comment behaviour after reporting changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact pupil/activity scope, period, figures, comments, attachment version and authorised recipient checked before sending; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R59, gross41 less upkeep3 gives net38. Low18 retains12 manual compilation hours,15 layout hours and17 comment hours where definitions and source notes are partly incompatible, plus35 source/review/send hours: R79, net18. High29 retains five compilation,12 layout and16 comment hours with fewer unmatched fields, plus35 other hours: R68, net29. Central retains no manual compilation,10 layout and14 comment hours only with compatible definitions; no generic range formula is used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep family discussion, safe supervision and professional support human while reducing specific record and report preparation.
reach: Administrators requesting reports used for actual decisions
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who keeps pupil support and administrative evidence clear without repeatedly reconstructing the same context.
